$comment: Every commit on a pull request carries its provedone receipt (a `Verified-by:` line) before it can merge. burgee is not listed: its `Quality Gate`, already required, needs the `provedone receipts` job (quality.yml), so a second required context would only add a name to keep in step with scripts/required-checks.mts. Admins and GitHub Actions (app 15368) bypass, so release and data-refresh pushes to main keep working. Applied by .github/workflows/rulesets.yml.
